title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Kaimi, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!

title_en: At Kaimi Complex, 1+1 Apartment With Regular Floor Plan For Sale!
description_en: In Ali Dem, at the Kaimi Complex, a 1+1 apartment with a regular floor plan is for sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​61.3 m2, net 53 m2 and is located on the 6th floor of a well-managed 7-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a bedroom and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is North-West. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, making it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment as the demand for rent is high. The price of the apartment is 11,000,000 lek. The property has full mortgage documentation.
